title: Compose manual pH and EC measurement in the PWA

gates.name: manual_measurement_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/manual-measurement.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser/API verification covers standalone pH/EC input, normalization, freshness reread, invalid ranges, permission/archive denial, and no optimistic residue.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-018 RED: no standalone manual pH/EC browser consumer exists; GREEN: exact authorized measurement input returns and renders normalized PostgreSQL values/freshness while invalid-range, permission, and archive cases remain non-mutating; decisive comparison: request, response/DOM, measurement/latest reread, and denial state; artifact: measurement evidence under .tasks/TASK-100-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose standalone manual pH/EC as a completion independent of daily check-in/observation.
success_outcome: An authorized Engineer can submit exact manual pH/EC and view authoritative normalized/freshness results while invalid or denied requests leave no optimistic or backend residue.
anti_goals: Do not implement daily check-in, sensor runtime, advice generation, or frontend-derived freshness.
Do not change backend normalization, Timeline, Dataset, or measurement authority.

stop_conditions: A required field/result is outside Plant Operations HTTP.
The PWA would need to infer normalized values, freshness, authorization, or attribution.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Plant Operations owns measurement, normalization, freshness, and audit.
Send only registered measurement fields and render backend values.
invariants: Rejected/archived measurement requests write no measurement, Timeline, or Dataset record.
Frontend display never becomes measurement or freshness authority.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-018: standalone pH/EC success, normalization/freshness, invalid ranges, permission/archive denial, and authoritative reread.
T3 harm proof uses isolated Plant state and confirms safe rerun/denial leaves no duplicate or optimistic measurement residue.
